title: INDIC QA BENCHMARK: A Multilingual Benchmark to Evaluate Question Answering capability of LLMs for Indic Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot Question Answering (QA) performance across 11 Indic languages using F1 and ROUGE metrics, and comparing direct source-language inference against a Translate-Test paradigm (translating inputs to English and outputs back to the source language) to measure the performance disparity caused by English-heavy training data.
